ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with localized high-intensity (white) circular points. Ratio of high-to-low intensity pixels is approximately 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular blobs (rosettes) are distributed throughout the dark field, with higher density toward the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations and several larger, jagged peaks across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the top trailing edge sweeping into convex outer margins reaching sharp, upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (annular rings) scattered across the ventral surface, likely representing barnacle attachment scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of barnacles (Coronula diadema) clustered on the extreme lateral tips and lower outer edges of both fluke lobes.
